# Month Grid

## Summary
Pure month arithmetic for a calendar view. `monthGrid(cursor)` returns the weeks to draw for the month containing `cursor`, always six weeks of seven `CalendarDay`s (`date`, `dayNumber`, whether it is in the month, whether it is today), padded with the neighbouring months' days so every month draws at the same height. `monthTitle(cursor)` is the heading ("October 2026"); `sameDay(a, b)` compares calendar days, not instants.

## Usage
```ts
import { monthGrid, monthTitle, sameDay } from '@cardstack/catalog/utils/month-grid';

let weeks = monthGrid(new Date(2026, 9, 1));
```

The Calendar component draws its grid from these.

## Non-goals
No events and no rendering. Weeks start on Sunday; there is no locale setting.
